# Detectors

Every registered rule, with the offline check it actually gets. The weak rows
are here on purpose: a rule that can only compare a prefix and a length says
so, rather than borrowing the credibility of the rules that carry a proof.

Only a rule in the `proof` column can put a finding in the confirmed tier.
See [confidence.md](confidence.md) for why.

| rule | name | offline check | strength | kind |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aws-access-key-id` | AWS access key ID | account ID extraction | structure | credential |
| `aws-secret-access-key` | AWS secret access key | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `generic-assignment` | Credential-shaped assignment | none | none | credential |
| `github-fine-grained-pat` | GitHub fine-grained personal access token | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `github-oauth-token` | GitHub OAuth access token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `github-pat` | GitHub personal access token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `github-refresh-token` | GitHub refresh token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `github-server-to-server` | GitHub server-to-server token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `github-user-to-server` | GitHub user-to-server token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `google-api-key` | Google API key | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `high-entropy-string` | Unclassified high-entropy string | none | none | credential |
| `json-web-token` | JSON web token | decodes, expiry readable | weak | credential |
| `npm-access-token` | npm access token | CRC32 checksum | proof | credential |
| `openai-api-key` | OpenAI API key | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `private-key` | Private key | ASN.1 key parse | proof | credential |
| `sendgrid-api-key` | SendGrid API key | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `slack-token` | Slack token | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `slack-webhook-url` | Slack incoming webhook URL | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `stripe-publishable-key` | Stripe publishable key | prefix and length only | weak | public by design |
| `stripe-secret-key` | Stripe secret key | prefix and length only | weak | credential |
| `twilio-account-sid` | Twilio account SID | prefix and length only | weak | public by design |
| `twilio-api-key` | Twilio API key SID | prefix and length only | weak | credential |

## Notes

- `aws-access-key-id`: Decodes to the owning account ID offline. No checksum exists in this format.
- `aws-secret-access-key`: No checksum and no structure. Only the assignment context distinguishes it.
- `generic-assignment`: Named by its variable rather than its shape. Noisy by construction.
- `github-fine-grained-pat`: Length contract only. The fine-grained format publishes no checksum.
- `github-oauth-token`: Last six characters are a base62 CRC32 of the preceding thirty.
- `github-pat`: Last six characters are a base62 CRC32 of the preceding thirty.
- `github-refresh-token`: Last six characters are a base62 CRC32 of the preceding thirty.
- `github-server-to-server`: Last six characters are a base62 CRC32 of the preceding thirty.
- `github-user-to-server`: Last six characters are a base62 CRC32 of the preceding thirty.
- `google-api-key`: Prefix and length only.
- `high-entropy-string`: No provider, no checksum, no contract. Advisory only: visible with --show ignore, never reportable on its own evidence.
- `json-web-token`: Header and payload decode offline, so expiry is settled without asking anyone.
- `npm-access-token`: Same base62 CRC32 scheme GitHub uses.
- `openai-api-key`: Prefix and length only. The hyphen separates this from Stripe's sk_ underscore form.
- `private-key`: The strongest check here. The DER underneath either parses as a key or it does not.
- `sendgrid-api-key`: Three-segment structure and length only.
- `slack-token`: Prefix and length only.
- `slack-webhook-url`: Structural URL shape only.
- `stripe-publishable-key`: Public by design. Detected so it can be dismissed explicitly rather than matched by a generic rule.
- `stripe-secret-key`: Prefix and length only. Stripe publishes no offline checksum.
- `twilio-account-sid`: Identifier rather than credential. Useless without the paired auth token.
- `twilio-api-key`: Prefix and hex length only. Collides readily with hex digests, so context does the work.
